reason: I fill my nights with PR people, WhatsApp lists and my regulars, not apps. Fifty euro a month plus VAT for three months minimum is real money on my margins, and I don't know if anyone in my town will open an app that isn't even public yet.
objection: A monthly fee with a 3-month commitment is too much for a bar like mine, when I don't know if any customers are on the app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app already used by people in my area, or a free tier or no minimum commitment so I can just try it with no risk.
